note: This text bundles several distinct tales; the clearest flood myth is the opening laurel-tree story (boy rides an uprooted tree, rescues ants and mosquitoes and another boy, lands on a mountain, and the survivors' marriages repopulate humanity), while later tales (Gim's adventure, the Dedong River story, and the tiger story) contain secondary flood or flood-like motifs (a magic rat's tail flood, a river flood, a flood used to fight tigers) that were not used to code the main fields.
name: Korea
